query: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM eval_resource_revisions r JOIN eval_executions x ON x.case_revision_id=r.id JOIN eval_experiments e ON e.id=x.experiment_id WHERE r.owner_id=$1 AND e.id<>$3 AND md5(((r.content->'content')-'partition')::text)=$2) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM eval_resource_revisions r WHERE r.owner_id=$1 AND r.id=ANY($4) AND r.content->'content'->>'partition'='development' AND md5(((r.content->'content')-'partition')::text)=$2)
